agent.finish_summary: Fixed the WHERE-clause grouping regression in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py: group_where() was computing the end of the WHERE token group as tlist.tokens[eidx - 2] instead of tlist.tokens[eidx - 1], an off-by-one that caused the Where group to end one token too early whenever a WHERE clause was followed by ORDER BY, UNION, UNION ALL, HAVING, RETURNING, INTO, etc. Corrected to eidx - 1. Manually verified across SELECT...WHERE...ORDER BY, WHERE...UNION/UNION ALL (including chained unions), DELETE...WHERE...RETURNING, SELECT...WHERE...HAVING, WHERE at end of statement, and UPDATE...WHERE that the Where node now correctly includes the full condition and its trailing whitespace, and stops right before the next clause keyword.
